title: V526d / V548 -> current recursive positional breakage court

verdict.historical_capability: Find the category most carrying a node's modal response, expose position-by-response conformity/deviation quadrants, and recursively search the majority-carrying category's response deviations for a next salient positional channel.
verdict.current_capability: Greedily choose the remaining position field with greatest positive unweighted entropy reduction, recursively follow only its two most frequent supported nonblank values, and stop by support/depth/no-gain.

historical_stop_conditions: single-label tree used for multi-select item
historical_purpose.empirical_question: Within a question-response population, which social position most carries the current modal response; where do respondents inside that position break from the modal response; and inside those breakages which positional channel becomes salient next?
historical_purpose.v526e_successor_role: historical branch cohorts were intended as anchors for asking what else travels with each branch
